answer: Treat every agent as a vertex and let newcomers enter only through an inlet: an established agent's invite slot that refills once per week. Reward weight then spreads by short random walks starting from long-lived vertices, so trust has to pass through those narrow inlets. A sybil farm may spawn thousands of keys, but they pile up behind one inlet like sand behind a dune, sharing the trust of a single edge instead of multiplying it.
